units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Σῶσον ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαόν σου καὶ εὐλόγησον τὴν κληρονομίαν σου· ἐπίσκεψαι τὸν κόσμον σου ἐν ἐλέει καὶ οἰκτιρμοῖς· ὕψωσον κέρας χριστιανῶν ὀρθοδόξων καὶ κατάπεμψον ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς τὰ ἐλέη σου τὰ πλούσια·
units.english: O God, save Your people and bless Your inheritance. Look upon Your world with mercy and compassion. Raise the Orthodox Christians in glory, and send down upon us Your rich mercies:
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: πρεσβείαις τῆς παναχράντου δεσποίνης ἡμῶν Θεοτόκου καὶ ἀειπαρθένου Μαρίας, δυνάμει τοῦ τιμίου καὶ ζωοποιοῦ Σταυροῦ, προστασίαις τῶν τιμίων ἐπουρανίων δυνάμεων ἀσωμάτων, ἱκεσίαις τοῦ τιμίου ἐνδόξου προφήτου προδρόμου καὶ βαπτιστοῦ Ἰωάννου, τῶν ἁγίων ἐνδόξων καὶ πανευφήμων ἀποστόλων, τῶν ἐν ἁγίοις πατέρων ἡμῶν μεγάλων ἱεραρχῶν καὶ οἰκουμενικῶν διδασκάλων Βασιλείου τοῦ Μεγάλου, Γρηγορίου τοῦ Θεολόγου καὶ Ἰωάννου τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου, Ἀθανασίου καὶ Κυρίλλου, Ἰωάννου τοῦ Ἐλεήμονος πατριαρχῶν Ἀλεξανδρείας· Νικολάου τοῦ ἐν Μύροις, Σπυρίδωνος ἐπισκόπου Τριμυθοῦντος, καὶ Νεκταρίου Πενταπόλεως τῶν θαυματουργῶν· τῶν ἁγίων ἐνδόξων μεγαλομαρτύρων Γεωργίου τοῦ τροπαιοφόρου, Δημητρίου τοῦ μυροβλήτου, Θεοδώρου τοῦ τήρωνος, Θεοδώρου τοῦ στρατηλάτου, Μηνᾶ τοῦ θαυματουργοῦ· τῶν ἱερομαρτύρων Χαραλάμπους καὶ Ἐλευθερίου, τῆς ἁγίας ἐνδόξου μεγαλομάρτυρος καὶ πανευφήμου Εὐφημίας· τῶν ἁγίων ἐνδόξων μαρτύρων Θέκλας, Βαρβάρας, Ἀναστασίας, Αἰκατερίνης, Κυριακῆς, Φωτεινῆς, Μαρίνης, Παρασκευῆς καὶ Εἰρήνης· τῶν ὁσίων καὶ θεοφόρων πατέρων ἡμῶν· (τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ ναοῦ)· τῶν ἁγίων καὶ δικαίων θεοπατόρων Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ Ἄννης, τῶν ἁγίων καὶ δικαίων, Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Μνήστορος, Δαυῒδ τοῦ Βασιλέως, καὶ Ἰακώβου τοῦ Ἀδελφοθέου, ὧν καὶ τὴν μνήμην ἐπιτελοῦμεν· καὶ πάντων σου τῶν ἁγίων·
units.english: through the intercessions of our all-immaculate Lady Theotokos and ever-virgin Mary, by the power of the precious and life-giving Cross, the protection of the honorable, heavenly, bodiless powers, the supplications of the honorable, glorious prophet and forerunner John the Baptist, the holy, glorious, and praiseworthy apostles, our fathers among the saints, the great hierarchs and ecumenical teachers Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom; Athanasius, Cyril, and John the Merciful, patriarchs of Alexandria, Nicholas, bishop of Myra, Spyridon, bishop of Trimythous, Nektarios of Pentapolis, the wonderworkers; the holy, glorious, great martyrs George the triumphant, Demetrios the myrrh-streamer, Theodore the soldier, and Theodore the general; Menas the wonderworker; Charalampus and Eleutherius, the hieromartyrs; the holy, glorious, and victorious martyrs; the glorious great Martyr and all-laudable Euphemia; the holy and glorious Martyrs Thecla, Barbara, Anastasia, Catherine, Kyriaki, Photini, Marina, Paraskevi and Irene; our venerable and God-bearing fathers; (local patron saint); the holy and righteous ancestors of God Joachim and Anna; of the holy and righteous Joseph the Betrothed, David the King, and James (Iakovos) the Brother of the Lord, whose memory we observe; and all Your saints:
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: ἱκετεύομέν σε, μόνε πολυέλεε Κύριε, ἐπάκουσον ἡμῶν τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν δεομένων σου καὶ ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: We beseech you, only merciful Lord, hear us sinners who pray to you and have mercy on us.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ἐλέει καὶ οἰκτιρμοῖς καὶ φιλανθρωπίᾳ τοῦ μονογενοῦς σου Υἱοῦ, μεθ’ οὗ εὐλογητὸς εἶ, σὺν τῷ παναγίῳ καὶ ἀγαθῷ καὶ ζωοποιῷ σου Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
units.english: Through the mercy, compassion, and love for humankind of Your only-begotten Son, with whom You are blessed, and Your all-holy, good and life-creating Spirit, now and ever and to the ages of ages.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀμήν.
units.english: Amen.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ὁ λαὸς ἵσταται διὰ τὴν Θʹ Ὠδήν.
units.english: Stand for the singing of Ode ix.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Τὴν Θεοτόκον καὶ μητέρα τοῦ φωτὸς ἐν ὕμνοις τιμῶντες μεγαλύνωμεν.
units.english: Let us honor and magnify in song the Theotokos and the Mother of the light.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Στίχ. Μεγαλύνει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν Κύριον, καὶ ἠγαλλίασε τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπὶ τῷ Θεῷ τῷ σωτῆρί μου.
units.english: Verse: My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβείμ, καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν, ἀσυγκρίτως τῶν Σεραφείμ, τὴν ἀδιαφθόρως, Θεὸν Λόγον τεκοῦσαν, τὴν ὄντως Θεοτόκον, σὲ μεγαλύνομεν.
units.english: Greater in honor than the Cherubim, and in glory greater beyond compare than the Seraphim; you without corruption gave birth to God the Word, and are truly Theotokos. You do we magnify.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Στίχ. Ὅτι ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ τὴν ταπείνωσιν τῆς δούλης αὐτοῦ· ἰδού γάρ, ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν μακαριοῦσί με πᾶσαι αἱ γενεαί.
units.english: Verse: For He has regarded the lowly state of His maidservant; for behold, henceforth all generations will call me blessed.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβείμ, καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν, ἀσυγκρίτως τῶν Σεραφείμ, τὴν ἀδιαφθόρως, Θεὸν Λόγον τεκοῦσαν, τὴν ὄντως Θεοτόκον, σὲ μεγαλύνομεν.
units.english: Greater in honor than the Cherubim, and in glory greater beyond compare than the Seraphim; you without corruption gave birth to God the Word, and are truly Theotokos. You do we magnify.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Στίχ. Ὅτι ἐποίησέ μοι μεγαλεῖα ὁ Δυνατός, καὶ ἅγιον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, καί το ἔλεος αὐτοῦ εἰς γενεάν, καὶ γενεὰν τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν.
units.english: Verse: For He who is mighty has done great things for me, and holy is His name. And His mercy is on those who fear Him from generation to generation.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβείμ, καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν, ἀσυγκρίτως τῶν Σεραφείμ, τὴν ἀδιαφθόρως, Θεὸν Λόγον τεκοῦσαν, τὴν ὄντως Θεοτόκον, σὲ μεγαλύνομεν.
units.english: Greater in honor than the Cherubim, and in glory greater beyond compare than the Seraphim; you without corruption gave birth to God the Word, and are truly Theotokos. You do we magnify.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Στίχ. Ἐποίησε κράτος ἐν βραχίονι αὐτοῦ, διεσκόρπισεν ὑπερηφάνους διανοίᾳ καρδίας αὐτῶν.
units.english: Verse: He has shown strength with His arm; He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβείμ, καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν, ἀσυγκρίτως τῶν Σεραφείμ, τὴν ἀδιαφθόρως, Θεὸν Λόγον τεκοῦσαν, τὴν ὄντως Θεοτόκον, σὲ μεγαλύνομεν.
units.english: Greater in honor than the Cherubim, and in glory greater beyond compare than the Seraphim; you without corruption gave birth to God the Word, and are truly Theotokos. You do we magnify.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Στίχ. Καθεῖλε δυνάστας ἀπὸ θρόνων, καὶ ὕψωσε ταπεινούς, πεινῶντας ἐνέπλησεν ἀγαθῶν, καὶ πλουτοῦντας ἐξαπέστειλε κενούς.
units.english: Verse: He has put down the mighty from their thrones, and exalted the lowly. He has filled the hungry with good things, and the rich He has sent away empty.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβείμ, καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν, ἀσυγκρίτως τῶν Σεραφείμ, τὴν ἀδιαφθόρως, Θεὸν Λόγον τεκοῦσαν, τὴν ὄντως Θεοτόκον, σὲ μεγαλύνομεν.
units.english: Greater in honor than the Cherubim, and in glory greater beyond compare than the Seraphim; you without corruption gave birth to God the Word, and are truly Theotokos. You do we magnify.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Στίχ. Ἀντελάβετο Ἰσραὴλ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ, μνησθῆναι ἐλέους, καθὼς ἐλάλησε πρὸς τοὺς Πατέρας ἡμῶν, τῷ Ἀβραάμ, καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος.
units.english: Verse: He has helped His servant Israel, in remembrance of His mercy, as He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed forever.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβείμ, καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν, ἀσυγκρίτως τῶν Σεραφείμ, τὴν ἀδιαφθόρως, Θεὸν Λόγον τεκοῦσαν, τὴν ὄντως Θεοτόκον, σὲ μεγαλύνομεν.
units.english: Greater in honor than the Cherubim, and in glory greater beyond compare than the Seraphim; you without corruption gave birth to God the Word, and are truly Theotokos. You do we magnify.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου, τὴν λυτρωσαμένην, ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς κατάρας.
units.english: O my soul, magnify her, through whom we were freed from the curse and condemnation.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Στέργειν μὲν ἡμᾶς, ὡς ἀκίνδυνον φόβῳ * Ῥᾷον σιωπῇ· τῷ πόθῳ δὲ Παρθένε * Ὕμνους ὑφαίνειν, συντόνως τεθηγμένους * Ἐργῶδές ἐστιν· ἀλλὰ καὶ Μήτηρ σθένος * Ὅση πέφυκεν, ἡ προαίρεσις δίδου.
units.english: To favor being silent out of caution is for us * Easy and free of risk, whereas to compose * Stirring hymns is arduous, but a labor of love * For you, all-holy Virgin. And so, we entreat you: * O Mother, empower us to succeed in this endeavor.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ἔτι καὶ ἔτι ἐν εἰρήνῃ τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: Again and again in peace let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ἀντιλαβοῦ, σῶσον, ἐλέησον καὶ διαφύλαξον ἡμᾶς, ὁ Θεός, τῇ σῇ χάριτι.
units.english: Help us, save us, have mercy on us, and protect us, O God, by Your grace.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Τῆς παναγίας, ἀχράντου, ὑπερευλογημένης, ἐνδόξου, δεσποίνης ἡμῶν Θεοτόκου καὶ ἀειπαρθένου Μαρίας μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων μνημονεύσαντες, ἑαυτοὺς καὶ ἀλλήλους καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ζωὴν ἡμῶν Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ παραθώμεθα.
units.english: Remembering our all-holy, immaculate, most blessed, and glorious Lady, the Theotokos and ever-virgin Mary, with all the saints, let us commend ourselves and one another and our whole life to Christ our God.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σοί, Κύριε.
units.english: To You, O Lord.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ὅτι σὲ αἰνοῦσι πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν καὶ σοὶ τὴν δόξαν ἀναπέμπουσι, τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ τῷ Υἱῷ καὶ τῷ ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
units.english: For all the powers of heaven praise You, and to You they offer up glory, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, now and ever and to the ages of ages.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀμήν.
units.english: Amen.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἅγιος Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν.
units.english: Holy is the Lord our God.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ.
units.english: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at the footstool of His feet.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ὅτι ἅγιός ἐστι.
units.english: For He is holy.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ὅτι ἦραν τὸν Κύριον, τῆς Μαρίας εἰπούσης, ἐπὶ τὸν τάφον ἔδραμον, Σίμων Πέτρος, καὶ ἄλλος, μύστης Χριστοῦ, ὃν ἠγάπα· ἔτρεχον δὲ οἱ δύο, καὶ εὗρον τὰ ὀθόνια, ἔνδον κείμενα μόνα, καὶ κεφαλῆς, ἦν δὲ τὸ σουδάριον χωρὶς τούτων· διὸ πάλιν ἡσύχασαν, τὸν Χριστὸν ἕως εἶδον.
units.english: When Mary Magdalene had said * that the Lord had been taken, * Simon Peter and also Christ’s * other beloved disciple * both ran to the tomb together. * Inside they found the napkin, * which had been on the Savior’s head, * not with the linen cloths that were lying there * by themselves, but rolled up and in its own place. * So until Christ appeared to them, * they went back home and rested.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σὺν Ἰακώβῳ μέλψωμεν, τῷ κλεινῷ θεαδέλφῳ, Δαυῒδ τὸν Θεοπάτορα, Ἰωσήφ τε τὸν θεῖον, τῆς Θεοτόκου Μνήστορα· τοῦ Χριστοῦ γὰρ τῇ θείᾳ γεννήσει καθυπούργησαν, Βηθλεὲμ ἐν τῇ πόλει, θεοπρεπῶς, μετ’ Ἀγγέλων Μάγων τε καὶ ποιμένων, αὐτῷ τὸν ὕμνον ᾄδοντες, ὡς Θεῷ καὶ Δεσπότῃ.
units.english: Let us extol the memory * of God’s ancestor David, * and the renowned Iakovos* Brother-of-God, and Joseph * the Theotokos’ divine Betrothed. * For they rendered their service * worthy of God in Bethlehem * at the divine Nativity of the Christ, * together with Angels, Magi and shepherds * singing a hymn of praise to Him* as to their God and Master.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἐπεσκέψατο ἡμᾶς, ἐξ ὕψους ὁ Σωτὴρ ἡμῶν, ἀνατολὴ ἀνατολῶν, καὶ οἱ ἐν σκότει καὶ σκιᾷ, εὕρομεν τὴν ἀλήθειαν· καὶ γὰρ ἐκ τῆς Παρθένου ἐτέχθη ὁ Κύριος.
units.english: Our Savior from on high * the Orient from the East * visited us who in the dark * and shadow hitherto had lain; * now we have found the truth indeed. * And this is so because from the Virgin the Lord is born.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Πᾶσα πνοὴ αἰνεσάτω τὸν Κύριον. Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν· αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις. Σοὶ πρέπει ὕμνος τῷ Θεῷ.
units.english: Let everything that breathes praise the Lord. Praise the Lord from the heavens, praise Him in the highest. It is fitting to sing a hymn to You, O God.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν, πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ· αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν, πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ. Σοὶ πρέπει ὕμνος τῷ Θεῷ.
units.english: Praise Him, all you His angels; praise Him, all you His hosts. It is fitting to sing a hymn to You, O God.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἥλιος καὶ σελήνη, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν πάντα τὰ ἄστρα καὶ τὸ φῶς.
units.english: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all you stars and light.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν οἱ οὐρανοὶ τῶν οὐρανῶν καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ὑπεράνω τῶν οὐρανῶν. Αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου.
units.english: Praise Him, you heavens of heavens, and you waters above the heavens. Let them praise the Lord’s name.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ὅτι αὐτὸς εἶπε, καὶ ἐγενήθησαν, αὐτὸς ἐνετείλατο, καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν.
units.english: For He spoke, and they were made; He commanded, and they were created.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ἔστησεν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος· πρόσταγμα ἔθετο, καὶ οὐ παρελεύσεται.
units.english: He established them forever and unto ages of ages; He set forth His ordinance, and it shall not pass away.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον ἐκ τῆς γῆς, δράκοντες καὶ πᾶσαι ἄβυσσοι.
units.english: Praise the Lord from the earth, you dragons and all the deeps.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Πῦρ, χάλαζα, χιών, κρύσταλλος, πνεῦμα καταιγίδος, τὰ ποιοῦντα τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ.
units.english: Fire and hail, snow and ice, stormy wind, which perform His word.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Τὰ ὄρη καὶ πάντες οἱ βουνοί, ξύλα καρποφόρα καὶ πᾶσαι κέδροι.
units.english: Mountains and all the hills, fruitful trees and all cedars.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Τὰ θηρία καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη, ἑρπετὰ καὶ πετεινὰ πτερωτά.
units.english: Wild animals and all cattle, creeping things and flying birds.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ πάντες λαοί, ἄρχοντες καὶ πάντες κριταὶ γῆς.
units.english: Kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Νεανίσκοι καὶ παρθένοι, πρεσβύτεροι μετὰ νεωτέρων· αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, ὅτι ὑψώθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ μόνου.
units.english: Young men and maidens, elders with younger, let them praise the Lord’s name, for His name alone is exalted.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ἡ ἐξομολόγησις αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ γῆς καὶ οὐρανοῦ. καὶ ὑψώσει κέρας λαοῦ αὐτοῦ.
units.english: His thanksgiving is in earth and heaven. And He shall exalt the horn of His people.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ὕμνος πᾶσι τοῖς ὁσίοις αὐτοῦ, τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ, λαῷ ἐγγίζοντι αὐτῷ.
units.english: A hymn for all His saints, for the children of Israel, a people who draw near to Him.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ἄσατε τῷ Κυρίῳ ᾆσμα καινόν, ἡ αἴνεσις αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ὁσίων.
units.english: Sing to the Lord a new song, His praise in the assembly of His holy ones.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Εὐφρανθήτω Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτόν, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Σιὼν ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν ἐπὶ τῷ βασιλεῖ αὐτῶν.
units.english: Let Israel be glad in Him who made him, and let the children of Zion greatly rejoice in their King.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐν χορῷ, ἐν τυμπάνῳ καὶ ψαλτηρίῳ ψαλάτωσαν αὐτῷ.
units.english: Let them praise His name with dance; with tambourine and harp let them sing to Him.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ὅτι εὐδοκεῖ Κύριος ἐν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑψώσει πραεῖς ἐν σωτηρίᾳ.
units.english: For the Lord is pleased with His people, and He shall exalt the gentle with salvation.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Καυχήσονται ὅσιοι ἐν δόξῃ καὶ ἀγαλλιάσονται ἐπὶ τῶν κοιτῶν αὐτῶν.
units.english: The holy ones shall boast in glory, and they shall greatly rejoice on their beds.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Αἱ ὑψώσεις τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῷ λάρυγγι αὐτῶν, καὶ ῥομφαῖαι δίστομοι ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν.
units.english: The high praise of God shall be in their mouth and a two-edged sword in their hand.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἐκδίκησιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ἐλεγμοὺς ἐν τοῖς λαοῖς.
units.english: To deal retribution to the nations, reproving among the peoples.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Τοῦ δῆσαι τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν ἐν πέδαις καὶ τοὺς ἐνδόξους αὐτῶν ἐν χειροπέδαις σιδηραῖς.
units.english: To shackle their kings with chains and their nobles with fetters of iron.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Στιχηρὸν Αʹ. Ἦχος δʹ.
units.english: Sticheron 1. Mode 4.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἐν αὐτοῖς κρῖμα ἔγγραπτον· δόξα αὕτη ἔσται πᾶσι τοῖς ὁσίοις αὐτοῦ.
units.english: To fulfill among them the written judgment: this glory have all His holy ones.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ὁ Σταυρὸν ὑπομείνας καὶ θάνατον, καὶ ἀναστὰς ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, παντοδύναμε Κύριε, δοξάζομέν σου τὴν ἀνάστασιν.
units.english: You endured the Cross and death, and You rose from the dead. O almighty Lord, we glorify Your resurrection.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Στιχηρὸν Βʹ. Ἦχος δʹ.
units.english: Sticheron 2. Mode 4.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Θεὸν ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν στερεώματι τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ.
units.english: Praise God in His saints; praise Him in the firmament of His power.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ σου Χριστέ, τῆς ἀρχαίας κατάρας, ἠλευθέρωσας ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ σου, τὸν τὴν φύσιν ἡμῶν τυραννήσαντα, διάβολον κατήργησας· ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐγέρσει σου, χαρᾶς τὰ πάντα ἐπλήρωσας· διὸ βοῶμεν σοι· Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, Κύριε δόξα σοι.
units.english: By Your Cross You freed us from the ancient curse, O Christ; and by Your death You neutralized the devil who tyrannized our nature; and by Your resurrection, You filled the whole world with joy. Therefore we sing to You, who rose from the dead, “Glory to You, O Lord.”
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Στιχηρὸν Γʹ. Ἦχος δʹ.
units.english: Sticheron 3. Mode 4.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐπὶ ταῖς δυναστείαις αὐτοῦ, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς μεγαλωσύνης αὐτοῦ.
units.english: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τῷ σῷ Σταυρῷ Χριστὲ Σωτήρ, ὁδήγησον ἡμᾶς ἐπὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου, καὶ ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς, τῶν παγίδων τοῦ ἐχθροῦ· ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, ἀνάστησον ἡμᾶς πεσόντας τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρά σου, φιλάνθρωπε Κύριε, τῇ πρεσβείᾳ τῶν Ἁγίων σου.
units.english: O Christ our Savior, by Your Cross, guide us to Your truth, and deliver us from the snares of the foe. Since You have risen from the dead, reach out Your hand and raise us who have fallen into sin, O benevolent Lord, at the intercession of Your Saints.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Στιχηρὸν Δʹ. Ἦχος δʹ.
units.english: Sticheron 4. Mode 4.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν ἤχῳ σάλπιγγος, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν ψαλτηρίῳ καὶ κιθάρᾳ.
units.english: Praise Him with the sound of trumpet; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τῶν πατρικῶν σου κόλπων, μὴ χωρισθεὶς μονογενὲς Λόγε τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἦλθες ἐπὶ γῆς διὰ φιλανθρωπίαν, ἄνθρωπος γενόμενος ἀτρέπτως, καὶ Σταυρὸν καὶ θάνατον ὑπέμεινας σαρκί, ὁ ἀπαθὴς τῇ θεότητι· ἀναστὰς δὲ ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἀθανασίαν παρέσχες τῷ γένει τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὡς μόνος παντοδύναμος.
units.english: Never parting from the Father’s bosom, Only-begotten Logos of God, You came to earth, for the sake of humanity, and without change became man. And in the flesh You endured the Cross and death, remaining impassible in divinity. As the only almighty Lord, You rose from the dead, and You granted immortality to the human race.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν τυμπάνῳ καὶ χορῷ, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν χορδαῖς καὶ ὀργάνῳ.
units.english: Praise Him with timbrel and dance; praise Him with strings and flute.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν κυμβάλοις εὐήχοις, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν κυμβάλοις ἀλαλαγμοῦ. Πᾶσα πνοὴ αἰνεσάτω τὸν Κύριον.
units.english: Praise Him with resounding cymbals; praise Him with triumphant cymbals; let everything that breathes praise the Lord.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Στίχ. Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ φθόγγος αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς τὰ πέρατα τῆς οἰκουμένης τὰ ῥήματα αὐτοῦ.
units.english: Verse: His proclamation went forth into all the earth, and his words to the ends of the world.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Στίχ. Οἱ οὐρανοὶ διηγοῦνται δόξαν Θεοῦ, ποίησιν δὲ χειρῶν αὐτοῦ ἀναγγέλλει τὸ στερέωμα.
units.english: Verse: The heavens declare the glory of God; the firmament shows the creation of His hands.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Δόξα. Τῆς Ἑορτῆς.
units.english: Glory. For the Feast.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Αἷμα καὶ πῦρ, καὶ ἀτμίδα Καπνοῦ, τέρατα γῆς, ἃ προεῖδεν Ἰωήλ, αἷμα τὴν Σάρκωσιν· πῦρ τὴν Θεότητα· ἀτμίδα δὲ καπνοῦ, τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον, τὸ ἐπελθὸν τῇ Παρθένῳ, καὶ κόσμον εὐωδιάσαν. Μέγα τὸ μυστήριον, τῆς σῆς ἐνανθρωπήσεως, Κύριε δόξα σοι.
units.english: Blood and fire and a cloud of smoke, portents on earth that Joel foresaw: blood, the incarnation; fire, the divinity; and the cloud of smoke, the Holy Spirit that came upon the Virgin and filled the world with fragrance. Great is the mystery of Your becoming human! Glory to You, O Lord.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Καὶ νῦν. Θεοτοκίον.
units.english: Both now. Theotokion.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις, Θεοτόκε Παρθένε· διὰ γὰρ τοῦ ἐκ σοῦ σαρκωθέντος, ὁ ᾅδης ἠχμαλώτισται, ὁ Ἀδὰμ ἀνακέκληται, ἡ κατάρα νενέκρωται, ἡ Εὔα ἠλευθέρωται, ὁ θάνατος τεθανάτωται, καὶ ἡμεις ἐζωοποιήθημεν· διὸ ἀνυμνοῦντες βοῶμεν· Εὐλογητὸς Χριστὸς ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, ὁ οὕτως εὐδοκήσας δόξα σοι.
units.english: You are supremely blessed, O Virgin Theotokos. For through Him who from you became incarnate, Hades has been captured, and Adam has been called back; the curse has been killed, and Eve has been freed; death has been put to death, and we have been brought back to life. Therefore we extol Him and cry out, “O Christ our God, You are blessed, for so was Your good pleasure. Glory to You!”
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ὁ λαὸς ἵσταται διὰ τὴν Μ. Δοξολογίαν.
units.english: Stand for the Great Doxology.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Δόξα σοι τῷ δείξαντι τὸ φῶς. Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις Θεῷ καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς εἰρήνη, ἐν ἀνθρώποις εὐδοκία.
units.english: Glory be to You who showed the light. Glory in the highest to God. His peace is on earth, His good pleasure in mankind.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ὑμνοῦμέν σε, εὐλογοῦμέν σε, προσκυνοῦμέν σε, δοξολογοῦμέν σε, εὐχαριστοῦμέν σοι, διὰ τὴν μεγάλην σου δόξαν.
units.english: We praise You, we bless You, we worship You, we glorify You, we give thanks to You for Your great glory.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Κύριε βασιλεῦ, ἐπουράνιε Θεέ, Πάτερ παντοκράτορ· Κύριε Υἱὲ μονογενές, Ἰησοῦ Χριστέ, καὶ Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα.
units.english: Lord King, heavenly God, Father, Ruler over all; Lord, only-begotten Son, Jesus Christ; and You, O Holy Spirit.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Κύριε ὁ Θεός, ὁ ἀμνὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Πατρός, ὁ αἴρων τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τοῦ κόσμου, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, ὁ αἴρων τὰς ἁμαρτίας τοῦ κόσμου.
units.english: Lord God, Lamb of God, Son of the Father, who take away the sin of the world, have mercy on us, You who take away the sins of the world.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Πρόσδεξαι τὴν δέησιν ἡμῶν, ὁ καθήμενος ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Πατρός, καὶ ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Accept our supplication, You who sit at the right hand of the Father, and have mercy on us.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ὅτι σὺ εἶ μόνος Ἅγιος, σὺ εἶ μόνος Κύριος, Ἰησοῦς Χριστός, εἰς δόξαν Θεοῦ Πατρός. Ἀμήν.
units.english: For You alone are holy, You alone are Lord, Jesus Christ, to the glory of God the Father. Amen.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Καθ’ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν εὐλογήσω σε καὶ αἰνέσω τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος.
units.english: Every day I will bless You, and Your name will I praise to eternity, and to the ages of ages.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Καταξίωσον, Κύριε, ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ, ἀναμαρτήτους φυλαχθῆναι ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Vouchsafe, O Lord, this day, that we be kept without sin.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Εὐλογητὸς εἶ, Κύριε, ὁ Θεὸς τῶν Πατέρων ἡμῶν, καὶ αἰνετὸν καὶ δεδοξασμένον τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας. Ἀμήν.
units.english: Blessed are You, O Lord, the God of our fathers, and praised and glorified is Your name to the ages. Amen.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Γένοιτο, Κύριε, τὸ ἔλεός σου ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς, καθάπερ ἠλπίσαμεν ἐπὶ σέ.
units.english: Let Your mercy be on us, O Lord, as we have set our hope on You.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Κύριε, δίδαξόν με τὰ δικαιώματά σου.
units.english: Blessed are You, O Lord. Teach me Your statutes.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Κύριε, δίδαξόν με τὰ δικαιώματά σου.
units.english: Blessed are You, O Lord. Teach me Your statutes.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Κύριε, δίδαξόν με τὰ δικαιώματά σου.
units.english: Blessed are You, O Lord. Teach me Your statutes.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Κύριε, καταφυγὴ ἐγενήθης ἡμῖν ἐν γενεᾷ καὶ γενεᾷ. Ἐγὼ εἶπα· Κύριε, ἐλέησόν με, ἴασαι τὴν ψυχήν μου, ὅτι ἥμαρτόν σοι.
units.english: Lord, You have been our refuge from generation to generation. I said: Lord, have mercy on me. Heal my soul, for I have sinned against You.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Κύριε, πρὸς σὲ κατέφυγον. Δίδαξόν με τοῦ ποιεῖν τὸ θέλημά σου, ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ Θεός μου.
units.english: Lord, I have fled to You. Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ὅτι παρὰ σοὶ πηγὴ ζωῆς, ἐν τῷ φωτί σου ὀψόμεθα φῶς.
units.english: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we shall see light.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Παράτεινον τὸ ἔλεός σου τοῖς γινώσκουσί σε.
units.english: Continue Your mercy to those who know You.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ἅγιος ὁ Θεός, Ἅγιος Ἰσχυρός, Ἅγιος Ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Δόξα Πατρὶ καὶ Υἱῷ καὶ Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι.
units.english: Glory to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Καὶ νῦν καὶ ἀεί, καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
units.english: Both now and ever and to the ages of ages. Amen.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ἅγιος Ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Holy Immortal, have mercy on us.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Ἅγιος ὁ Θεός, Ἅγιος Ἰσχυρός, Ἅγιος Ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῆς Δοξολογίας λέγομεν Τροπάριον Ἀναστάσιμον.
units.english: After the Doxology, sing the following Resurrectional Troparion.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σήμερον σωτηρία τῷ κόσμῳ γέγονεν. ᾌσωμεν τῷ ἀναστάντι ἐκ τάφου καὶ ἀρχηγῷ τῆς ζωῆς ἡμῶν· καθελὼν γὰρ τῷ θανάτῳ τὸν θάνατον, τὸ νῖκος ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν, καὶ τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
units.english: Today has salvation come to pass in the world. Let us sing to Him who resurrected from the tomb and is the Author of our life. For, destroying death by death, He gave us the victory and the great mercy.
units.service_title: Matins (Orthros)

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Εὐλόγησον, δέσποτα.
units.english: Master bless.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Εὐλογημένη ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου Πνεύματος, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
units.english: Blessed is the kingdom of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, now and ever and to the ages of ages.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀμήν.
units.english: Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ἐν εἰρήνῃ τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: In peace let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ τῆς ἄνωθεν εἰρήνης καὶ τῆς σωτηρίας τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For the peace from above and for the salvation of our souls, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ τῆς εἰρήνης τοῦ σύμπαντος κόσμου, εὐσταθείας τῶν ἁγίων τοῦ Θεοῦ Ἐκκλησιῶν καὶ τῆς τῶν πάντων ἑνώσεως τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For the peace of the whole world, for the stability of the holy churches of God, and for the unity of all, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἁγίου οἴκου τούτου καὶ τῶν μετὰ πίστεως, εὐλαβείας καὶ φόβου Θεοῦ εἰσιόντων ἐν αὐτῷ, τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For this holy house and for those who enter it with faith, reverence, and the fear of God, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ τῶν εὐσεβῶν καὶ ὀρθοδόξων χριστιανῶν τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For pious and Orthodox Christians, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ἀρχιεπισκόπου ἡμῶν (δεῖνος), τοῦ τιμίου πρεσβυτερίου, τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ διακονίας, παντὸς τοῦ κλήρου καὶ τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For our Archbishop (name), for the honorable presbyterate, for the diaconate in Christ, and for all the clergy and the people, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ τοῦ εὐσεβοῦς ἡμῶν γένους, τοῦ Προέδρου, πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας ἐν τῷ κράτει ἡμῶν, καὶ τοῦ κατὰ ξηράν, θάλασσαν, καὶ ἀέρα φιλοχρίστου ἡμῶν στρατοῦ, τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For our country, the president, all those in public service, and for our armed forces everywhere, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ τῆς Ἁγίας τοῦ Χριστοῦ Μεγάλης Ἐκκλησίας Κωνσταντινουπόλεως, τῆς Ἱερᾶς ἡμῶν Ἀρχιεπισκοπῆς, [τῆς Ἁγίας Μητροπόλεως ταύτης,] τῆς πόλεως καὶ κοινότητος ταύτης, πάσης πόλεως, χώρας καὶ τῶν πίστει οἰκούντων ἐν αὐταῖς, τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For the Holy and Great Church of Christ of Constantinople, for our Sacred Archdiocese, [for this Holy Metropolis,] for this city and parish, for every city and land, and for the faithful who live in them, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ εὐκρασίας ἀέρων, εὐφορίας τῶν καρπῶν τῆς γῆς καὶ καιρῶν εἰρηνικῶν τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For favorable weather, for an abundance of the fruits of the earth, and for peaceful times, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ πλεόντων, ὁδοιπορούντων, νοσούντων, καμνόντων, αἰχμαλώτων καὶ τῆς σωτηρίας αὐτῶν τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For those who travel by land, sea, and air, for the sick, the suffering, the captives and for their salvation, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ὑπὲρ τοῦ ῥυσθῆναι ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης θλίψεως, ὀργῆς, κινδύνου καὶ ἀνάγκης, τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: For our deliverance from all affliction, wrath, danger, and distress, let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ἀντιλαβοῦ, σῶσον, ἐλέησον καὶ διαφύλαξον ἡμᾶς, ὁ Θεός, τῇ σῇ χάριτι.
units.english: Help us, save us, have mercy on us, and protect us, O God, by Your grace.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Τῆς παναγίας, ἀχράντου, ὑπερευλογημένης, ἐνδόξου, δεσποίνης ἡμῶν Θεοτόκου καὶ ἀειπαρθένου Μαρίας μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων μνημονεύσαντες, ἑαυτοὺς καὶ ἀλλήλους καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ζωὴν ἡμῶν Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ παραθώμεθα.
units.english: Remembering our all-holy, immaculate, most blessed, and glorious Lady, the Theotokos and ever-virgin Mary, with all the saints, let us commend ourselves and one another and our whole life to Christ our God.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σοί, Κύριε.
units.english: To You, O Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: ΕΥΧΗ Αʹ ΑΝΤΙΦΩΝΟΥ
units.english: PRAYER OF FIRST ANTIPHON
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Κύριε ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, οὗ τὸ κράτος ἀνείκαστον καὶ ἡ δόξα ἀκατάληπτος, οὗ τὸ ἔλεος ἀμέτρητον καὶ ἡ φιλανθρωπία ἄφατος· αὐτός, Δέσποτα, κατὰ τὴν εὐσπλαγχνίαν σου, ἐπίβλεψον ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν ἅγιον οἶκον τοῦτον καὶ ποίησον μεθ’ ἡμῶν καὶ τῶν συνευχομένων ἡμῖν πλούσια τὰ ἐλέη σου καὶ τοὺς οἰκτιρμούς σου.
units.english: Lord, our God, whose dominion is incomparable and glory incomprehensible; whose mercy is immeasurable, and love for humankind ineffable: Look upon us and upon this holy house in Your loving-kindness, and grant to us and to those who pray with us Your abundant mercy and compassion.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (Aloud)
units.greek: Ὅτι πρέπει σοι πᾶσα δόξα, τιμὴ καὶ προσκύνησις, τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ τῷ Υἱῷ καὶ τῷ ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
units.english: For to You belong all glory, honor, and worship, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, now and ever and to the ages of ages.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀμήν.
units.english: Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι, Κύριε, ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου, διηγήσομαι πάντα τὰ θαυμάσιά σου.
units.english: I will give thanks to You, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will tell of all Your wondrous things.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Savior, save us.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἐν βουλῇ εὐθέων καὶ συναγωγῇ, μεγάλα τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου.
units.english: In the council of the upright and in the assembly. Great are the works of the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Savior, save us.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἐξεζητημένα εἰς πάντα τὰ θελήματα αὐτοῦ.
units.english: Sought out in all things with regard to His will.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Savior, save us.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἐξομολόγησις καὶ μεγαλοπρέπεια τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος.
units.english: Thanksgiving and majesty are His work, and His righteousness continues unto ages of ages.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Savior, save us.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (Aloud)
units.greek: Δόξα· καὶ νῦν.
units.english: Glory. Both now.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Savior, save us.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ἔτι καὶ ἔτι ἐν εἰρήνῃ τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: Again and again in peace let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ἀντιλαβοῦ, σῶσον, ἐλέησον καὶ διαφύλαξον ἡμᾶς, ὁ Θεός, τῇ σῇ χάριτι.
units.english: Help us, save us, have mercy on us, and protect us, O God, by Your grace.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Τῆς παναγίας, ἀχράντου, ὑπερευλογημένης, ἐνδόξου, δεσποίνης ἡμῶν Θεοτόκου καὶ ἀειπαρθένου Μαρίας μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων μνημονεύσαντες, ἑαυτοὺς καὶ ἀλλήλους καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ζωὴν ἡμῶν Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ παραθώμεθα.
units.english: Remembering our all-holy, immaculate, most blessed, and glorious Lady, the Theotokos and ever-virgin Mary, with all the saints, let us commend ourselves and one another and our whole life to Christ our God.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σοί, Κύριε.
units.english: To You, O Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: ΕΥΧΗ Βʹ ΑΝΤΙΦΩΝΟΥ
units.english: PRAYER OF SECOND ANTIPHON
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Κύριε ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, σῶσον τὸν λαόν σου καὶ εὐλόγησον τὴν κληρονομίαν σου· τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς Ἐκκλησίας σου φύλαξον· ἁγίασον τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας τὴν εὐπρέπειαν τοῦ οἴκου σου· σὺ αὐτοὺς ἀντιδόξασον τῇ θεϊκῇ σου δυνάμει καὶ μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς ἡμᾶς τοὺς ἐλπίζοντας ἐπὶ σέ.
units.english: Lord, our God, save Your people and bless Your inheritance. Protect all the members of Your Church. Sanctify those who love the beauty of Your house. Glorify them in return by Your divine power, and forsake us not who have set our hope in You.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (Aloud)
units.greek: Ὅτι σὸν τὸ κράτος καὶ σοῦ ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία καὶ ἡ δύναμις καὶ ἡ δόξα, τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου Πνεύματος, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
units.english: For Yours is the dominion, and Yours is the kingdom and the power and the glory, of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, now and ever and to the ages of ages.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀμήν.
units.english: Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Μακάριος ἀνὴρ ὁ φοβούμενος τὸν Κύριον, ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς αὐτοῦ θελήσει σφόδρα.
units.english: Blessed is the man who fears the Lord; he will delight exceedingly in His commandments.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐκ Παρθένου τεχθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα.
units.english: Save us, O Son of God, who were born of a Virgin. We sing to You, Alleluia.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Δυνατὸν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ.
units.english: His seed shall be mighty on earth.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐκ Παρθένου τεχθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα.
units.english: Save us, O Son of God, who were born of a Virgin. We sing to You, Alleluia.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Δόξα καὶ πλοῦτος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος.
units.english: Glory and riches shall be in his house, and his righteousness continues unto ages of ages.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐκ Παρθένου τεχθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα.
units.english: Save us, O Son of God, who were born of a Virgin. We sing to You, Alleluia.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἐξανέτειλεν ἐν σκότει φῶς τοῖς εὐθέσιν.
units.english: For the upright, light springs up in darkness.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐκ Παρθένου τεχθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα.
units.english: Save us, O Son of God, who were born of a Virgin. We sing to You, Alleluia.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Δόξα Πατρὶ καὶ Υἱῷ καὶ ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι.
units.english: Glory to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Καὶ νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
units.english: Both now and ever and to the ages of ages. Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ὁ μονογενὴς Υἱὸς καὶ Λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἀθάνατος ὑπάρχων καὶ καταδεξάμενος διὰ τὴν ἡμετέραν σωτηρίαν σαρκωθῆναι ἐκ τῆς ἁγίας Θεοτόκου καὶ ἀειπαρθένου Μαρίας, ἀτρέπτως ἐνανθρωπήσας, σταυρωθείς τε, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός, θανάτῳ θάνατον πατήσας, εἷς ὢν τῆς ἁγίας Τριάδος, συνδοξαζόμενος τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ τῷ ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι, σῶσον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Only-begotten Son and Logos of God, being immortal, You condescended for our salvation to take flesh from the holy Theotokos and ever-virgin Mary and, without change, became man. Christ, our God, You were crucified and conquered death by death. Being one of the Holy Trinity, glorified with the Father and the Holy Spirit: Save us.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ἔτι καὶ ἔτι ἐν εἰρήνῃ τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: Again and again in peace let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ἀντιλαβοῦ, σῶσον, ἐλέησον καὶ διαφύλαξον ἡμᾶς, ὁ Θεός, τῇ σῇ χάριτι.
units.english: Help us, save us, have mercy on us, and protect us, O God, by Your grace.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Τῆς παναγίας, ἀχράντου, ὑπερευλογημένης, ἐνδόξου, δεσποίνης ἡμῶν Θεοτόκου καὶ ἀειπαρθένου Μαρίας μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων μνημονεύσαντες, ἑαυτοὺς καὶ ἀλλήλους καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ζωὴν ἡμῶν Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ παραθώμεθα.
units.english: Remembering our all-holy, immaculate, most blessed, and glorious Lady, the Theotokos and ever-virgin Mary, with all the saints, let us commend ourselves and one another and our whole life to Christ our God.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Σοί, Κύριε.
units.english: To You, O Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: ΕΥΧΗ Γʹ ΑΝΤΙΦΩΝΟΥ
units.english: PRAYER OF THIRD ANTIPHON
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Ὁ τὰς κοινὰς ταύτας καὶ συμφώνους ἡμῖν χαρισάμενος προσευχάς, ὁ καὶ δυσὶ καὶ τρισὶ συμφωνοῦσιν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου τὰς αἰτήσεις παρέχειν ἐπαγγειλάμενος· αὐτὸς καὶ νῦν τῶν δούλων σου τὰ αἰτήματα πρὸς τὸ συμφέρον πλήρωσον, χορηγῶν ἡμῖν ἐν τῷ παρόντι αἰῶνι τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τῆς σῆς ἀληθείας καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι ζωὴν αἰώνιον χαριζόμενος.
units.english: Lord, You have granted us to offer these common prayers in unison and have promised that when two or three agree in Your name, You will grant their requests. Fulfill now, O Lord, the petitions of Your servants as may be of benefit to them, granting us in the present age the knowledge of Your truth, and in the age to come eternal life.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (Aloud)
units.greek: Ὅτι ἀγαθὸς καὶ φιλάνθρωπος Θεὸς ὑπάρχεις καὶ σοὶ τὴν δόξαν ἀναπέμπομεν, τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ τῷ Υἱῷ καὶ τῷ ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
units.english: For You are good and benevolent God, and to You we offer up glory, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, now and ever and to the ages of ages.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀμήν.
units.english: Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Εἶπεν ὁ Κύριος τῷ Κυρίῳ μου· Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου, ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου.
units.english: The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of Your feet.”
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ῥάβδον δυνάμεως ἐξαποστελεῖ σοι Κύριος ἐκ Σιών.
units.english: The Lord shall send forth the rod of Your power from Zion.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Μετὰ σοῦ ἡ ἀρχὴ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τῆς δυνάμεώς σου, ἐν ταῖς λαμπρότησι τῶν ἁγίων σου.
units.english: With You is the beginning in the day of Your power, in the brightness of Your saints.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (Aloud)
units.greek: Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἑορτῆς. Ἦχος δʹ.
units.english: Apolytikion of the Feast. Mode 4.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἡ Γέννησίς σου Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, ἀνέτειλε τῷ κόσμῳ, τὸ φῶς τὸ τῆς γνώσεως· ἐν αὐτῇ γὰρ οἱ τοῖς ἄστροις λατρεύοντες, ὑπὸ ἀστέρος ἐδιδάσκοντο, σὲ προσκυνεῖν, τὸν Ἥλιον τῆς δικαιοσύνης, καὶ σὲ γινώσκειν ἐξ ὕψους ἀνατολήν. Κύριε δόξα σοι.
units.english: Your nativity, O Christ our God, has caused the light of knowledge to rise upon the world. For therein the worshippers of the stars were by a star instructed to worship You, the Sun of Righteousness, and to know You as Orient from on high. Glory to You, O Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (Aloud)
units.greek: Ψαλλομένου δὲ τοῦ Γʹ Ἀντιφώνου (μετὰ τῶν στίχων), ὁ Ἱερεὺς καὶ ὁ Διάκονος στάντες ἔμπροσθεν τῆς ἁγίας Τραπέζης προσκυνοῦσι τρίς. Ὁ Ἱερεὺς εἶτα τὸ ἱερὸν Εὐαγγέλιον δίδωσι τῷ Διακόνῳ, ὅστις παραλαμβάνων αὐτὸ ἀσπάζεται τὴν χεῖρα τοῦ Ἱερέως καί, προπορευομένου λαμπαδούχου καὶ ἑξαπτερύγων, περιέρχεται κύκλῳ τὴν ἁγίαν Τράπεζαν, ἑπομένου τοῦ Ἱερέως καὶ ποιοῦσιν εἴσοδον (τὴν λεγομένην μικράν). Μὴ ὑπάρχοντος δὲ Διακόνου λαμβάνει τὸ ἱερὸν Εὐαγγέλιον ὁ Ἱερεὺς πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ. Διασχίσαντες δὲ τὸ βόρειον κλίτος καὶ τὸ κεντρικὸν ἔρχονται εἰς τὸ μέσον τοῦ ναοῦ καὶ σταθέντες κλίνουσι τὰς κεφαλάς, τοῦ Διακόνου εἰπόντος·
units.english: As the Third Antiphon is being sung (with its verses), the Priest and Deacon bow three times before the holy Table. Then the Priest gives the holy Gospel to the Deacon, who kisses the Priest’s hand as he receives it, and then circles the holy Table with the Priest following him. Preceded by altar servers holding candles and fans, they exit through the north door for the so-called Small Entrance. When there is no Deacon, the Priest takes the holy Gospel and holds it up in front of his face. When they reach the center of the church, they stop and bow their heads, and the Deacon says in a low voice:
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν. Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Let us pray to the Lord. Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: ΕΥΧΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΙΣΟΔΟΥ
units.english: ENTRANCE PRAYER
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Δέσποτα Κύριε, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, ὁ καταστήσας ἐν οὐρανοῖς τάγματα καὶ στρατιὰς ἀγγέλων καὶ ἀρχαγγέλων εἰς λειτουργίαν τῆς σῆς δόξης, ποίησον σὺν τῇ εἰσόδῳ ἡμῶν εἴσοδον ἁγίων ἀγγέλων γενέσθαι, συλλειτουργούντων ἡμῖν καὶ συνδοξολογούντων τὴν σὴν ἀγαθότητα. Ὅτι πρέπει σοι πᾶσα δόξα, τιμὴ καὶ προσκύνησις, τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ τῷ Υἱῷ καὶ τῷ ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
units.english: Master, Lord our God, who has established the orders and hosts of angels and archangels in heaven to minister to Your glory, grant that holy angels may enter with us, that together we may celebrate and glorify Your goodness. For to You belong all glory, honor, and worship, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, now and ever and to the ages of ages. Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Εὐλόγησον, δέσποτα, τὴν ἁγίαν εἴσοδον.
units.english: Master, bless the holy entrance.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Εὐλογημένη ἡ εἴσοδος τῶν ἁγίων σου πάντοτε, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
units.english: Blessed be the entrance of Your holy ones always, now and ever and to the ages of ages. Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon (Aloud)
units.greek: Σοφία. Ὀρθοί.
units.english: Wisdom. Arise.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν καὶ προσπέσωμεν Χριστῷ. Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα.
units.english: Come, let us worship and bow down before Christ. Save us, O Son of God, risen from the dead. We sing to You, Alleluia.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τὸ φαιδρὸν τῆς ἀναστάσεως κήρυγμα, ἐκ τοῦ Ἀγγέλου μαθοῦσαι αἱ τοῦ Κυρίου Μαθήτριαι, καὶ τὴν προγονικὴν ἀπόφασιν ἀποῤῥίψασαι, τοῖς Ἀποστόλοις καυχώμεναι ἔλεγον· Ἐσκύλευται ὁ θάνατος, ἠγέρθη Χριστὸς ὁ Θεός, δωρούμενος τῷ κόσμῳ τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
units.english: When the women disciples of the Lord heard the Angel joyously proclaim the resurrection, they cast aside the ancestral verdict, and boasting in glory they said to the Apostles, “Death has been despoiled! Christ God has risen, granting the great mercy to the world!”
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἑορτῆς.
units.english: Apolytikion of the Feast.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἡ Γέννησίς σου Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, ἀνέτειλε τῷ κόσμῳ, τὸ φῶς τὸ τῆς γνώσεως· ἐν αὐτῇ γὰρ οἱ τοῖς ἄστροις λατρεύοντες, ὑπὸ ἀστέρος ἐδιδάσκοντο, σὲ προσκυνεῖν, τὸν Ἥλιον τῆς δικαιοσύνης, καὶ σὲ γινώσκειν ἐξ ὕψους ἀνατολήν. Κύριε δόξα σοι.
units.english: Your nativity, O Christ our God, has caused the light of knowledge to rise upon the world. For therein the worshippers of the stars were by a star instructed to worship You, the Sun of Righteousness, and to know You as Orient from on high. Glory to You, O Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Εὐαγγελίζου Ἰωσήφ, τῷ Δαυῒδ τὰ θαύματα τῷ Θεοπάτορι· Παρθένον εἶδες κυοφορήσασαν, μετὰ Μάγων προσεκύνησας, μετὰ Ποιμένων ἐδοξολόγησας, δι’ Ἀγγέλου χρηματισθείς. Ἱκέτευε Χριστὸν τὸν Θεόν, σωθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.
units.english: Annunciate the miracles to David the ancestor of God, O Joseph. You saw the Virgin pregnant. You glorified with the shepherds. You worshipped with the Magi. And you were warned by an Angel. Entreat Christ God to save our souls.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ψάλλεται τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ναοῦ.
units.english: The Apolytikion of the parish church is sung.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Εἴτα·
units.english: Then:
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κοντάκιον.
units.english: Kontakion.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον, τὸν Ὑπερούσιον τίκτει, καὶ ἡ γῆ τὸ Σπήλαιον, τῷ ἀπροσίτῳ προσάγει. Ἄγγελοι, μετὰ Ποιμένων δοξολογοῦσι. Μάγοι δέ, μετὰ ἀστέρος ὁδοιποροῦσι· δι’ ἡμᾶς γὰρ ἐγεννήθη, Παιδίον νέον, ὁ πρὸ αἰώνων Θεός.
units.english: On this day the Virgin gives * birth to the Super-essential. * To the Unapproachable, * earth is providing the grotto. * Angels sing and with the shepherds offer up glory. * Following a star the Magi are still proceeding. * He was born for our salvation, a newborn Child, the pre-eternal God.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Τοῦ Κυρίου δεηθῶμεν.
units.english: Let us pray to the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Κύριε, ἐλέησον.
units.english: Lord, have mercy.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: ΕΥΧΗ ΤΟΥ ΤΡΙΣΑΓΙΟΥ ΥΜΝΟΥ
units.english: PRAYER OF THE TRISAGIOS HYMN
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Ὁ Θεὸς ὁ ἅγιος, ὁ ἐν ἁγίοις ἀναπαυόμενος, ὁ τρισαγίῳ φωνῇ ὑπὸ τῶν Σεραφεὶμ ἀνυμνούμενος καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν Χερουβεὶμ δοξολογούμενος καὶ ὑπὸ πάσης ἐπουρανίου δυνάμεως προσκυνούμενος· ὁ ἐκ τοῦ μὴ ὄντος εἰς τὸ εἶναι παραγαγὼν τὰ σύμπαντα· ὁ κτίσας τὸν ἄνθρωπον κατ’ εἰκόνα σὴν καὶ ὁμοίωσιν καὶ παντί σου χαρίσματι κατακοσμήσας· ὁ διδοὺς αἰτοῦντι σοφίαν καὶ σύνεσιν καὶ μὴ παρορῶν ἁμαρτάνοντα, ἀλλὰ θέμενος ἐπὶ σωτηρίᾳ μετάνοιαν· ὁ καταξιώσας ἡμᾶς τοὺς ταπεινοὺς καὶ ἀναξίους δούλους σου καὶ ἐν τῇ ὥρᾳ ταύτῃ στῆναι κατενώπιον τῆς δόξης τοῦ ἁγίου σου θυσιαστηρίου καὶ τὴν ὀφειλομένην σοι προσκύνησιν καὶ δοξολογίαν προσάγειν· αὐτός, Δέσποτα, πρόσδεξαι καὶ ἐκ στόματος ἡμῶν τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν τὸν τρισάγιον ὕμνον καὶ ἐπίσκεψαι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῇ χρηστότητί σου. Συγχώρησον ἡμῖν πᾶν πλημμέλημα ἑκούσιόν τε καὶ ἀκούσιον· ἁγίασον ἡμῶν τὰς ψυχὰς καὶ τὰ σώματα· καὶ δὸς ἡμῖν ἐν ὁσιότητι λατρεύειν σοι πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς ἡμῶν· πρεσβείαις τῆς ἁγίας Θεοτόκου καὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων τῶν ἀπ’ αἰῶνός σοι εὐαρεστησάντων.
units.english: O Holy God, who is resting among the holy ones, praised by the Seraphim with the thrice-holy voice, glorified by the Cherubim, and worshiped by every celestial power, You have brought all things into being out of nothing. You have created man according to Your image and likeness and adorned him with all the gifts of Your grace. You give wisdom and understanding to the one who asks, and You overlook not the sinner, but have set repentance as the way of salvation. You have granted us, Your humble and unworthy servants, to stand even at this hour before the glory of Your holy Altar of sacrifice and to offer to You due worship and praise. Master, accept the Trisagion Hymn also from the lips of us sinners, and visit us in Your goodness. Forgive all our voluntary and involuntary transgressions, sanctify our souls and bodies, and grant that we may worship You in holiness all the days of our lives, through the intercessions of the holy Theotokos and of all the saints who have pleased You throughout the ages.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (Aloud)
units.greek: Ὅτι ἅγιος εἶ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ σοὶ τὴν δόξαν ἀναπέμπομεν, τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ τῷ Υἱῷ καὶ τῷ ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεί…
units.english: For You, our God, are holy, and to You we offer up glory, to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, now and ever…
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
units.english: and to the ages of ages.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀμήν.
units.english: Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἅγιος ὁ Θεός, ἅγιος Ἰσχυρός, ἅγιος Ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Δόξα Πατρὶ καὶ Υἱῷ καὶ ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι. Καὶ νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
units.english: Glory to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit. Both now and ever and to the ages of ages. Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἅγιος Ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Holy Immortal, have mercy on us.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Δύναμις.
units.english: Dynamis.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Κέλευσον, δέσποτα.
units.english: With your blessing, Master.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου.
units.english: Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Εὐλόγησον, δέσποτα, τὴν ἄνω καθέδραν.
units.english: Master, bless the throne on high.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Εὐλογημένος εἶ, ὁ ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης τῆς βασιλείας σου, ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῶν Χερουβείμ, πάντοτε, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
units.english: Blessed are You upon the throne of the glory of Your kingdom, enthroned upon the Cherubim always, now and ever and to the ages of ages. Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Δύναμις.
units.english: Dynamis.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἅγιος ὁ Θεός, ἅγιος Ἰσχυρός, ἅγιος Ἀθάνατος, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς.
units.english: Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Τοῦ Πρωτομάρτυρος.
units.english: For Protomartyr.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Πρόσχωμεν.
units.english: Let us be attentive.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Σοφία.
units.english: Wisdom.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Reader
units.greek: Πρὸς Γαλάτας Ἐπιστολῆς Παύλου τὸ ἀνάγνωσμα.
units.english: The reading is from Paul’s Letter to the Galatians.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Πρόσχωμεν.
units.english: Let us be attentive.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Reader
units.greek: Ἀδελφοί, γνωρίζω ὑμῖν τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν ὑπ᾽ ἐμοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστι κατὰ ἄνθρωπον· οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐγὼ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου παρέλαβον αὐτὸ οὔτε ἐδιδάχθην, ἀλλὰ δι᾽ ἀποκαλύψεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ. Ἠκούσατε γὰρ τὴν ἐμὴν ἀναστροφήν ποτε ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ, ὅτι καθ᾽ ὑπερβολὴν ἐδίωκον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐπόρθουν αὐτήν, καὶ προέκοπτον ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὑπὲρ πολλοὺς συνηλικιώτας ἐν τῷ γένει μου, περισσοτέρως ζηλωτὴς ὑπάρχων τῶν πατρικῶν μου παραδόσεων. Ὅτε δὲ εὐδόκησεν ὁ Θεὸς ὁ ἀφορίσας με ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου καὶ καλέσας διὰ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἀποκαλύψαι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐμοί, ἵνα εὐαγγελίζωμαι αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, εὐθέως οὐ προσανεθέμην σαρκὶ καὶ αἵματι, οὐδὲ ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα πρὸς τοὺς πρὸ ἐμοῦ ἀποστόλους, ἀλλὰ ἀπῆλθον εἰς Ἀραβίαν, καὶ πάλιν ὑπέστρεψα εἰς Δαμασκόν. Ἔπειτα μετὰ ἔτη τρία ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἱστορῆσαι Πέτρον, καὶ ἐπέμεινα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡμέρας δεκαπέντε· ἕτερον δὲ τῶν ἀποστόλων οὐκ εἶδον εἰ μὴ Ἰάκωβον τὸν ἀδελφὸν τοῦ Κυρίου.
units.english: Brethren, I would have you know that the gospel which was preached by me is not according to man. For I did not receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came through a revelation of Jesus Christ. For you have heard of my former life in Judaism, how I persecuted the church of God violently and tried to destroy it; and I advanced in Judaism beyond many of my own age among my people, so extremely zealous was I for the traditions of my fathers. But when God who had set me apart before I was born, and had called me through his grace, was pleased to reveal his Son in me, in order that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I did not confer with flesh and blood, nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia; and again I returned to Damascus. Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas, and remained with him fifteen days. But I saw none of the other apostles except James the Lord’s brother.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Εἰρήνη σοὶ τῷ ἀναγνόντι.
units.english: Peace be with you the reader.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀλληλούϊα. Ἀλληλούϊα. Ἀλληλούϊα.
units.english: Alleluia. Alleluia. Alleluia.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: (Ψάλλεται Ἀλληλούϊα τρίς. Οἱ στίχοι εὑρίσκονται εἰς τὸ Liturgy - Variable Parts τῆς ἡμέρας.)
units.english: (Alleluia is sung thrice. Verses may be found in the Liturgy - Variable Parts of the day.)
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: ΕΥΧΗ ΤΟΥ ΕΥΑΓΓΕΛΙΟΥ
units.english: PRAYER OF THE GOSPEL
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Ἔλλαμψον ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν, φιλάνθρωπε Δέσποτα, τὸ τῆς σῆς θεογνωσίας ἀκήρατον φῶς καὶ τοὺς τῆς διανοίας ἡμῶν διάνοιξον ὀφθαλμοὺς εἰς τὴν τῶν εὐαγγελικῶν σου κηρυγμάτων κατανόησιν. Ἔνθες ἡμῖν καὶ τὸν τῶν μακαρίων σου ἐντολῶν φόβον, ἵνα, τὰς σαρκικὰς ἐπιθυμίας καταπατήσαντες, πνευματικὴν πολιτείαν μετέλθωμεν, πάντα τὰ πρὸς εὐαρέστησιν τὴν σὴν καὶ φρονοῦντες καὶ πράττοντες. Σὺ γὰρ εἶ ὁ φωτισμὸς τῶν ψυχῶν καὶ τῶν σωμάτων ἡμῶν, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός, καὶ σοὶ τὴν δόξαν ἀναπέμπομεν σὺν τῷ ἀνάρχῳ σου Πατρὶ καὶ τῷ παναγίῳ καὶ ἀγαθῷ καὶ ζωοποιῷ σου Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
units.english: Shine in our hearts, O benevolent Lord, the pure light of Your divine knowledge, and open the eyes of our mind that we may comprehend the proclamations of Your Gospels. Instill in us the fear that Your blessed commandments inspire, so that, crushing carnal desires, we may seek the spiritual citizenship, thinking and doing all those things that are pleasing to You. For You, Christ our God, are the illumination of our souls and bodies, and to You we offer up glory, and to Your Father, who is without beginning, and Your all-holy, good, and life-creating Spirit, now and ever and to the ages of ages. Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Σοφία. Ὀρθοί. Ἀκούσωμεν τοῦ ἁγίου Εὐαγγελίου.
units.english: Wisdom. Arise. Let us hear the holy Gospel.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Εἰρήνη πᾶσι.
units.english: Peace be with all.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Καὶ τῷ πνεύματί σου.
units.english: And with your spirit.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ἐκ τοῦ κατὰ Ματθαῖον ἁγίου Εὐαγγελίου τὸ ἀνάγνωσμα.
units.english: The reading is from the holy Gospel according to Matthew.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Πρόσχωμεν.
units.english: Let us be attentive.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Δόξα σοι, Κύριε, δόξα σοι.
units.english: Glory to You, O Lord, glory to You.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Deacon
units.greek: Ἀναχωρησάντων τῶν μάγων, ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος Κυρίου φαίνεται κατ’ ὄναρ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ λέγων· ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ φεῦγε εἰς Αἴγυπτον, καὶ ἴσθι ἐκεῖ ἕως ἂν εἴπω σοι· μέλλει γὰρ Ἡρῴδης ζητεῖν τὸ παιδίον τοῦ ἀπολέσαι αὐτό. Ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς καὶ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον, καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς τελευτῆς Ἡρῴδου, ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ὑπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἐκάλεσα τὸν υἱόν μου. Τότε Ἡρῴδης ἰδὼν ὅτι ἐνεπαίχθη ὑπὸ τῶν μάγων, ἐθυμώθη λίαν, καὶ ἀποστείλας ἀνεῖλε πάντας τοὺς παῖδας τοὺς ἐν Βηθλεὲμ καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῆς ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κατωτέρω, κατὰ τὸν χρόνον ὃν ἠκρίβωσε παρὰ τῶν μάγων. τότε ἐπληρώθη τὸ ῥηθὲν ὑπὸ Ἱερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· φωνὴ ἐν Ῥαμᾷ ἠκούσθη, θρῆνος καὶ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὀδυρμὸς πολύς· Ῥαχὴλ κλαίουσα τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐκ ἤθελε παρακληθῆναι, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσίν. Τελευτήσαντος δὲ τοῦ Ἡρῴδου ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος Κυρίου κατ’ ὄναρ φαίνεται τῷ Ἰωσὴφ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ λέγων· ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πορεύου εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ· τεθνήκασι γὰρ οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ παιδίου. ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ. ἀκούσας δὲ ὅτι Ἀρχέλαος βασιλεύει ἐπὶ τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἀντὶ Ἡρῴδου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, ἐφοβήθη ἐκεῖ ἀπελθεῖν· χρηματισθεὶς δὲ κατ’ ὄναρ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὰ μέρη τῆς Γαλιλαίας, καὶ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς πόλιν λεγομένην Ναζαρέτ, ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τῶν προφητῶν ὅτι Ναζωραῖος κληθήσεται.
units.english: When the magi had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Rise, take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt, and remain there till I tell you; for Herod is about to search for the child, to destroy him.” And he rose and took the child and his mother by night, and departed to Egypt, and remained there until the death of Herod. This was to fulfill what the Lord had spoken by the prophet, “Out of Egypt have I called my son.” Then Herod, when he saw that he had been tricked by the magi, was in a furious rage, and he sent and killed all the male children in Bethlehem and in all that region who were two years old or under, according to the time which he had ascertained from the magi. Then was fulfilled what was spoken by the prophet Jeremiah: “A voice was heard in Ramah, wailing and loud lamentation, Rachel weeping for her children; she refused to be consoled, because they were no more.” But when Herod died, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying, “Rise, take the child and his mother, and go to the land of Israel, for those who sought the child’s life are dead.” And he rose and took the child and his mother, and went to the land of Israel. But when he heard that Archelaus reigned over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there, and being warned in a dream he withdrew to the district of Galilee. And he went and dwelt in a city called Nazareth, that what was spoken by the prophets might be fulfilled, “He shall be called a Nazarene.”
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest
units.greek: Εἰρήνη σοὶ τῷ εὐαγγελιζομένῳ.
units.english: Peace be with you who read the Gospel.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Δόξα σοι, Κύριε, δόξα σοι.
units.english: Glory to You, O Lord, glory to You.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: ΕΥΧΗ ΠΙΣΤΩΝ Bʹ
units.english: SECOND PRAYER FOR THE FAITHFUL
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Πάλιν καὶ πολλάκις σοὶ προσπίπτομεν καὶ σοῦ δεόμεθα, ἀγαθὲ καὶ φιλάνθρωπε, ὅπως ἐπιβλέψας ἐπὶ τὴν δέησιν ἡμῶν καθαρίσῃς ἡμῶν τὰς ψυχὰς καὶ τὰ σώματα ἀπὸ παντὸς μολυσμοῦ σαρκὸς καὶ πνεύματος καὶ δῴης ἡμῖν ἀνένοχον καὶ ἀκατάκριτον τὴν παράστασιν τοῦ ἁγίου σου θυσιαστηρίου. Χάρισαι δέ, ὁ Θεός, καὶ τοῖς συνευχομένοις ἡμῖν προκοπὴν βίου καὶ πίστεως καὶ συνέσεως πνευματικῆς· δὸς αὐτοῖς πάντοτε, μετὰ φόβου καὶ ἀγάπης λατρεύουσί σοι, ἀνενόχως καὶ ἀκατακρίτως μετέχειν τῶν ἁγίων σου μυστηρίων καὶ τῆς ἐπουρανίου σου βασιλείας ἀξιωθῆναι.
units.english: Again and countless times we fall down before You, and we implore You, O good and benevolent Lord: That You, having regarded our prayer, may cleanse our souls and bodies from every defilement of flesh and spirit, and grant to us to stand before Your holy Altar of sacrifice, free of guilt and condemnation. Grant also, O God, to those who pray with us, progress in life, faith, and spiritual understanding. Grant that they always worship You with awe and love, partake of Your holy sacrament without guilt or condemnation, and be deemed worthy of Your celestial kingdom.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (Aloud)
units.greek: Ὅπως ὑπὸ τοῦ κράτους σου πάντοτε φυλαττόμενοι, σοὶ δόξαν ἀναπέμπωμεν, τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ τῷ Υἱῷ καὶ τῷ ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
units.english: That, ever guarded by Your might, we may ascribe glory to You, to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever and to the ages of ages.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Ἀμήν.
units.english: Amen.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Choir
units.greek: Οἱ τὰ Χερουβεὶμ μυστικῶς εἰκονίζοντες καὶ τῇ ζωοποιῷ Τριάδι τὸν τρισάγιον ὕμνον προσᾴδοντες, πᾶσαν νῦν βιοτικὴν ἀποθώμεθα μέριμναν, ὡς τὸν βασιλέα τῶν ὅλων ὑποδεξόμενοι.
units.english: Let us, who mystically represent the Cherubim and who sing the thrice-holy hymn to the life-creating Trinity, now lay aside every worldly care. So that we may receive the King of all.
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: ΕΥΧΗ ΤΟΥ ΧΕΡΟΥΒΙΚΟΥ ΥΜΝΟΥ
units.english: PRAYER OF THE CHERUBIC HYMN
units.service_title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom

units.speaker: Priest (In A Low Voice)
units.greek: Οὐδεὶς ἄξιος τῶν συνδεδεμένων ταῖς σαρκικαῖς ἐπιθυμίαις καὶ ἡδοναῖς προσέρχεσθαι ἢ προσεγγίζειν ἢ λειτουργεῖν σοι, βασιλεῦ τῆς δόξης· τὸ γὰρ διακονεῖν σοι μέγα καὶ φοβερὸν καὶ αὐταῖς ταῖς ἐπουρανίαις δυνάμεσιν. Ἀλλ’ ὅμως διὰ τὴν ἄφατον καὶ ἀμέτρητόν σου φιλανθρωπίαν ἀτρέπτως καὶ ἀναλλοιώτως γέγονας ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἀρχιερεὺς ἡμῶν ἐχρημάτισας καὶ τῆς λειτουργικῆς ταύτης καὶ ἀναιμάκτου θυσίας τὴν ἱερουργίαν παρέδωκας ἡμῖν ὡς Δεσπότης τῶν ἁπάντων. Σὺ γὰρ μόνος, Κύριε ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δεσπόζεις τῶν ἐπουρανίων καὶ τῶν ἐπιγείων, ὁ ἐπὶ θρόνου χερουβικοῦ ἐποχούμενος, ὁ τῶν Σεραφεὶμ Κύριος καὶ βασιλεὺς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, ὁ μόνος ἅγιος καὶ ἐν ἁγίοις ἀναπαυόμενος. Σὲ τοίνυν δυσωπῶ τὸν μόνον ἀγαθὸν καὶ εὐήκοον· ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ’ ἐμὲ τὸν ἁμαρτωλὸν καὶ ἀχρεῖον δοῦλόν σου καὶ καθάρισόν μου τὴν ψυχὴν καὶ τὴν καρδίαν ἀπὸ συνειδήσεως πονηρᾶς· καὶ ἱκάνωσόν με τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ ἁγίου σου Πνεύματος, ἐνδεδυμένον τὴν τῆς ἱερατείας χάριν, παραστῆναι τῇ ἁγίᾳ σου ταύτῃ τραπέζῃ καὶ ἱερουργῆσαι τὸ ἅγιον καὶ ἄχραντόν σου Σῶμα καὶ τὸ τίμιον Αἷμα. Σοὶ γὰρ προσέρχομαι κλίνας τὸν ἐμαυτοῦ αὐχένα καὶ δέομαί σου· μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ, μηδὲ ἀποδοκιμάσῃς με ἐκ παίδων σου, ἀλλ’ ἀξίωσον προσενεχθῆναί σοι ὑπ’ ἐμοῦ τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ καὶ ἀναξίου δούλου σου τὰ δῶρα ταῦτα. Σὺ γὰρ εἶ ὁ προσφέρων καὶ προσφερόμενος καὶ προσδεχόμενος καὶ διαδιδόμενος, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, καὶ σοὶ τὴν δόξαν ἀναπέμπομεν σὺν τῷ ἀνάρχῳ σου Πατρὶ καὶ τῷ παναγίῳ καὶ ἀγαθῷ καὶ ζωοποιῷ σου Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
units.english: No one bound by carnal desires and pleasures is worthy to approach, draw near, or minister to You, the King of Glory. For to serve You is great and awesome even for the heavenly powers. Yet, because of Your ineffable and immeasurable love for humankind, You impassibly and immutably became man. You, as the Master of all, became our high priest and delivered unto us the sacred service of this liturgical and bloodless sacrifice. Indeed, Lord our God, You alone reign over the celestial and the terrestrial; borne aloft on the cherubic throne, Lord of the Seraphim and King of Israel, the only holy and resting among the holy ones. I now beseech You, who alone are good and inclined to hear: Look down upon me, Your sinful and unprofitable servant, and cleanse my soul and heart of a wicked conscience. Vested as I am with the grace of priesthood by the power of Your Holy Spirit, make me sufficient to stand before Your holy Table and perform the sacrament of Your holy and pure Body and Your precious Blood. I come before You, with my head bowed, and I implore You: Turn not Your face away from me, nor reject me from among Your children, but make me, Your sinful and unworthy servant, worthy to offer these gifts to You.
